title: Alfie gets deep

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Good to... see you again. I know... I know. Time for session two. Just... gimme a minute, k?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good to... see you again. I know... I know. Time for session two. Just... gimme a minute, k?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Me? No. I mean, I have no reason to complain. All the opportunities are right there waiting for us. The only thing standing in our way is our own excuses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? No. I mean, I have no reason to complain. All the opportunities are right there waiting for us. The only thing standing in our way is our own excuses.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Fuck, ok... Let's get started then. What did we cover last time? Career and love and all of that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck, ok... Let's get started then. What did we cover last time? Career and love and all of that?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Nah, there's not much I CAN say. Except all this excellent, free advice I can offer you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nah, there's not much I CAN say. Except all this excellent, free advice I can offer you!

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Well I got plenty more advice for you. A million Lims worth of advice, for no fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I got plenty more advice for you. A million Lims worth of advice, for no fee.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Two key areas of Nivalis life are Community and Depression.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Two key areas of Nivalis life are Community and Depression.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: The first thing to know about depression is that it's normal, but it's also not real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The first thing to know about depression is that it's normal, but it's also not real.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Everyone feels depressed if they let themselves. You're supposed to feel depressed. It's a sign.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone feels depressed if they let themselves. You're supposed to feel depressed. It's a sign.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: A sign that you're lingering in your emotions. That you're not staying active, pushing forward. Depression is what you feel when you are too focused on yourself and not enough on your responsibilities to your coworkers and employers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A sign that you're lingering in your emotions. That you're not staying active, pushing forward. Depression is what you feel when you are too focused on yourself and not enough on your responsibilities to your coworkers and employers.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Of course I'm on to something! You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course I'm on to something! You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Of course it's true. You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course it's true. You never see someone with real hustle feeling depressed. They're too busy chasing every opportunity, waking at 4 AM, working out, pitching new business ideas, micro-dosing plum extract, soaking their underwear in caffeine syrup.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: That's right! You see these people all the time. They never stop. We have a name for them. Winners. They never have time to be depressed while they're on the streets of Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right! You see these people all the time. They never stop. We have a name for them. Winners. They never have time to be depressed while they're on the streets of Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: They pass out! They don't have time to feel anything. They're numb! Nothing can hurt a speeding bullet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They pass out! They don't have time to feel anything. They're numb! Nothing can hurt a speeding bullet.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: That's it! You got it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's it! You got it.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: The thing you have to remember about community is that no matter how appealing it feels to rely on other people, it will weaken your character and make you dependent on strangers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The thing you have to remember about community is that no matter how appealing it feels to rely on other people, it will weaken your character and make you dependent on strangers.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? It's the WORST thing. Every sociological disaster and every societal collapse has been caused by an overdeveloped sense of community among the citizenry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you kidding me? It's the WORST thing. Every sociological disaster and every societal collapse has been caused by an overdeveloped sense of community among the citizenry.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Absolutely! Think about it. What else can destabilize business, compromise the status quo and mortally wound a vibrant, healthy economy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Absolutely! Think about it. What else can destabilize business, compromise the status quo and mortally wound a vibrant, healthy economy?

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: A what? No. The answer is too much community. Too many people misconstruing commercial sabotage as charity and taking on altruistic vanity projects.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A what? No. The answer is too much community. Too many people misconstruing commercial sabotage as charity and taking on altruistic vanity projects.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: What is this, the Age of Salubrity again? No, the danger is community, especially community projects.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is this, the Age of Salubrity again? No, the danger is community, especially community projects.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: ANY kind of projects - if they don't foster economic growth. Look, I'm no economitian, but even I know that labor that doesn't encourage growth is morally wrong.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ANY kind of projects - if they don't foster economic growth. Look, I'm no economitian, but even I know that labor that doesn't encourage growth is morally wrong.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: I'd be careful with this kind of loose thinking if I was you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd be careful with this kind of loose thinking if I was you.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Haha, yeah? Wait, are you fucking with me? I don't know if you're joking. But you must be...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, yeah? Wait, are you fucking with me? I don't know if you're joking. But you must be...

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Sounds like you're even further down the road to success than me. That's... great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you're even further down the road to success than me. That's... great.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Well I think we're making real progress. You must feel great now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I think we're making real progress. You must feel great now.

nodes.speaker: Alfie Gunfibel
nodes.text: Stick with it. One more session and I think we'll see a real breakthrough. You'll see. You'll see.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stick with it. One more session and I think we'll see a real breakthrough. You'll see. You'll see.

nodes.text: Me? Fucking... whatever. I gotta do this. I gotta say this shit. Complaining won't help. There's no way out for me.
